import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000100;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int P = 6151;
    static final int T = 2000;
    static final int SQ = 280;
    static final int lg = 64;
    static final int lg2 = 34;

    static int n, d;
    static List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Node {
        int[][] dp = new int[lg2][lg2];
        int[][] cnt = new int[lg2][lg2];
        boolean[] mark = new boolean[lg2];
        boolean[] tark = new boolean[lg2];

        void merge(Node other) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= d; k++) {
                        long val = ((long)dp[k][j] * (long)other.dp[i][k]) % MOD;
                        cnt[i][j] = (int)((cnt[i][j] + val) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                if (mark[i] && !other.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[i][j] = dp[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!mark[i] && other.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[j][i] = other.dp[j][i];
                    }
                }
                mark[i] |= other.mark[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int x) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) {
                    int ni = (i + x) % d;
                    int nj = (j + x) % d;
                    cnt[ni][nj] = dp[i][j];
                }
                cnt[(i + x) % d][d] = dp[i][d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                cnt[d][(i + x) % d] = dp[d][i];
            }
            cnt[d][d] = dp[d][d];

            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                tark[i] = mark[(i + x) % d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                mark[i] = tark[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static Node[] md = new Node[lg + 5];
    static Node[] hp = new Node[lg + 5];
    static Node ht = new Node();

    static Node get_node(int x) {
        int h = x, pw = 1, t = -1;
        while (h >= d) {
            h /= d;
            pw *= d;
            t++;
        }
        x %= pw;
        if (t == -1) {
            return hp[h];
        }
        Node ans = md[t];
        ht = md[t];
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            ht.shift(1);
            ans.merge(ht);
        }
        ht = get_node(x);
        ht.shift(h);
        ans.merge(ht);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        n--;
        int m = n;
        while (n > 0) {
            v.add(n % d);
            n /= d;
        }

        // Initialize hp[0]
        hp[0] = new Node();
        hp[0].dp[d][d] = 2;
        hp[0].dp[d][0] = -1;
        hp[0].dp[0][d] = 1;
        hp[0].mark[0] = true;

        // Initialize md[0]
        md[0] = new Node();
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                md[0].dp[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        md[0] = hp[0];

        for (int i = 1; i < d; i++) {
            hp[i] = new Node();
            hp[i].dp[d][d] = 2;
            hp[i].dp[d][i] = -1;
            hp[i].dp[i][d] = 1;
            hp[i].mark[i] = true;
            md[0].merge(hp[i]);
            hp[i] = md[0];
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= v.size(); i++) {
            md[i] = new Node();
            // Copy md[i-1] into md[i]
            for (int r = 0; r <= d; r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= d; c++) {
                    md[i].dp[r][c] = md[i - 1].dp[r][c];
                }
            }
            ht = new Node();
            ht = md[i - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < d; j++) {
                ht.shift(1);
                md[i].merge(ht);
            }
        }

        Node ans = get_node(m);
        System.out.println(ans.dp[d][d]);
    }
}
